starboard.label: Starboard
starboard.description: Reposts messages that get enough star ⭐ reactions to a channel.

channelId.label: Starboard channel
channelId.help: The channel where copies are posted. While it is empty, the module reposts nothing. Best left read-only for members: anything written there by hand is not tracked.

emoji.label: Trigger emoji
emoji.help: The one reaction that counts: every other emoji on a message is ignored. A server emoji works — but if it is deleted later, reactions already placed stop being recognised.

threshold.label: Reactions required
threshold.help: How many times the emoji must be added for a message to reach the board. This number decides how rare it feels: too low and the board becomes a second general channel. Size it against your busy channels, not against the server.

ignoreBots.label: Ignore messages from bots
ignoreBots.help: Stops messages written by a bot from reaching the board, even when they collect enough reactions. Best left on: otherwise an automated announcement that gathers stars gets reposted twice.

g0.label: ⭐ Starboard
g0.description: The bot watches reactions in every channel it can read: as soon as a message hits the threshold, it reposts a copy into the board channel. The copy tracks the original — its counter updates, and it disappears if the message falls back below the threshold or is deleted.
